title: Small rocket just got 47 bookings
title_candidates: Rocket Lab just signed the biggest launch deal in their history
One company has now booked 47 rockets from the same small launcher
The private rocket company quietly becoming the world's most booked
Rocket Lab's top customer just ordered 20 more rockets
This is what Rocket Lab's record-breaking launch contract looks like
caption:
Rocket Lab just signed the biggest commercial launch deal in their history: 20 new rockets for one customer, 47 total.

The customer is Synspective, a Japanese satellite company that uses radar to photograph the Earth from above. Flood zones, construction sites, disaster areas. More launches means more satellites, which means sharper, more frequent images of the whole planet.

Most rocket companies celebrate a single contract. Rocket Lab just stacked 47 of them with one client. That is what happens when a small rocket actually shows up on time.
